source_text: COGITANTI mihi, una cum animo meo conferenti, de fabrica mundi istius, in quo clausi tenemur, etiam velocitas fabricae istius haec est; sicut in libro Moysis continetur, quem de conditione ipsius scripsit, qui Genesis appellatur. Totam molem istam, Deus sex diebus in ornamento majestatis suae expressit, septimo quibus benedictione. . . consecravit. Idcirco igitur, quoniam septenario numero dierum et coelestia et terrestria reguntur, principii loco, de hac septimam ad omnium septimanarium rigionum metibor, et prout potuero, virtutis diem in eam consummationem conabor exprimere.
pass_a_gloss: Cogitanti on fabrica mundi: Genesis shows velocitas of six-day mass for majestas ornament; seventh consecrated with benedictio. Septenario numero dierum both caelestia et terrestria are ruled—author will treat from that seventh toward consummation.
pass_b_english: As I am thinking and conferring with my own mind concerning the fabric of this world in which we are kept enclosed, such also is the speed of that fabric, as is contained in the book of Moses which he wrote about its founding, which is called Genesis. God expressed this whole mass in six days for the adornment of His majesty; on the seventh He consecrated it with a blessing. Therefore, because by the septenary number of days both heavenly and earthly things are ruled, I will measure from this seventh as a starting point toward all the septenary regions, and as far as I am able I will try to express the day's power unto that consummation.

lemmas.sense: heavenly and earthly ruled by seven-day number

choices.choose: Read the week as providential rule of heaven and earth
choices.reject: Treat days as bare chronology without governance
choices.why: septenario numero dierum et coelestia et terrestria reguntur

choices.choose: Keep seventh-day consecration as the interpretive key
choices.reject: Stop at six-day production without sabbath blessing

notes: Fate-and-foreknowledge: creation week as septenary rule of cosmic order.
